text: Training Objectives: To cultivate talents with a comprehensive, broad and all-round disciplinary knowledge structure, who possess systematic knowledge of light industry science and technology, are familiar with the production characteristics and product features of light industry enterprises, as well as the application and research status of light industry technologies. They have a solid theoretical foundation in technical economy and management science, understand knowledge in finance and law, and can use relevant methods and models to analyze and solve specific problems in the light industry and enterprises. They are competent for senior technical management positions in light industry enterprises, research and teaching in research institutions and universities, and high-level management positions in government departments or consulting agencies.Main Courses: Including Chinese Marxism and Contemporary Issues, Research on Frontiers of Economics and Management, Selections from Classic Works of Marxism, Scientific Ethics and Academic Norms, Special Topics in Technical Economy and Management, Research on the Development Strategy of Light Industry, Innovation and Management in Light Industry, Economic Forecasting and Decision-making in Light Industry, Professional Literature Reading and Reviewing, etc.
